answers.collision_check: No charter requires the current behaviour; Rule 1 holds because the fix lives inside the owning component and its proof measures only that component.
answers.falsifier_check: Clauses: (1) a good injected fetch writes percent and resets_at for seven_day and five_hour with fetched_at, and last() reads it fresh with its age | (2) a failing fetch after a good one is written as an error beside the unchanged last_good, and last() reports state error with the old reading, never fresh | (3) the OAuth token appears in neither the store file nor anything printed, including when the fetch's own error message contains it | (4) a missing credentials file or an empty token is a recorded error, and --hook returns 0 on every failure | (5) the proof reaches no network: urlopen is patched to raise during every tooth. Horizon: the proof runs green on akiendell.
answers.gates_bound: proof gate (a hollow build must fail it) + durability gate (committed) + feeds-back-to-origin on failure (Laws 3 + 8).
answers.missing_check: Only the named files were censused; other sites with the same pattern may exist, and the proof's grep or run is what would show them.
